sections.title: Sliding door visual check
sections.text: With the vehicle secured and switched off, inspect the sliding-door track for visible debris or damage. Record any resistance or abnormal noise and refer the vehicle to a qualified technician; do not force the door or adjust its mechanism during the service-desk check.

sections.title: Tyre condition check
sections.text: Check each tyre for visible cuts, bulges, embedded objects, or obvious loss of pressure. Record the observation and arrange inspection by a qualified technician when damage or pressure loss is suspected.
